additional_info.subject: ID0478398-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S4 170003364] Charger malfunction CRM:02888000606
additional_info.body:
Dear Laszlo,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we see that indeed in the given timestamp the errors appeared in the logs.
These logs are from 1 a 2 months ago, and right now the charger looks healthy, with no errors showing.
We will be monitoring the charger for the next three days, to see if any of these errors appear again.
We are only able to perform an on-site check, when the error is live.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
